title: Smoky Beef Koftas
description: Indian-inspired beef koftas with a smoky twist, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef mince, greek yogurt, crushed loukoumades, cumin powder, coriander powder, paprika, and salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 4-6 koftas, depending on desired size.
Thread the koftas onto skewers, leaving a little space between each one.
Grill the koftas for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as naan or rice.
Optional: serve with a dollop of raita (yogurt and cucumber sauce) to balance the spiciness.
